Menu highlights

A few of the dishes from the kitchen. Ask for the full menu at the table.

Appetisers

  • SpanakopitaFlaky pastry filled with spinach and feta cheese, baked to golden perfection.
  • Tzatziki dipCreamy yogurt dip with cucumber and garlic, served with warm pita bread.
  • DolmadakiaGrape leaves stuffed with rice, herbs, and spices, served with lemon.

Main courses

  • MoussakaLayered dish of eggplant, ground beef, and béchamel sauce, baked until bubbly.
  • Grilled octopusTender octopus marinated in olive oil and lemon, grilled to perfection.
  • Souvlaki skewersJuicy marinated pork skewers, grilled and served with tzatziki and pita.

Sweets

  • BaklavaSweet pastry made of layers of filo, filled with nuts and honey syrup.
  • GalaktobourekoCustard-filled pastry wrapped in filo and soaked in syrup, a delightful treat.
  • PortokalopitaFluffy and colourful and soaked in a delicious orange scented syrup! A mouthwatering Greek Orange cake with the aroma of fresh oranges.

From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own website.

Where tradition meets taste

Dias Zeus has been run by husband and wife Michalis and Maria since 2010. The restaurant was selected by The Culture Trip as one of the ten best cultural restaurants in Cyprus and has received Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice awards and Certificates of Excellence for thirteen years in succession.

Blue and white on every table, the moussaka guests keep coming back for, and fish and seafood from the Mediterranean.
